fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-08-24, around 21:50, farm fencing of the complainant was damaged near Palar Layout Market Road, with a repair estimate of about Rs. 30,000, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-08-27. A witness, Meena Sekar, reachable on 9000000196, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Mathan Velan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000147. The complaint refers to Dinesh Balan, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000363. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs and a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00174, as the mobile number 9000000147 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Damage reportedly caused overnight by unidentified persons.
fields.Keywords: property damage, vandalism, mobile number, suspect, market road, witness, night, photograph
